title: Amazon's Adorable UFO Cat Bed Gives Kitties an Out-of-This-World Place To Nap
byline: PetHelpfulFollowMandi JacewiczTue, September 22, 2026 at 1:25 AM UTCAdd us on Google
excerpt: A cozy little spaceship made for cat naps.
content:
PetHelpful and Yahoo may earn commission from links in this article.

Cats are experts at finding odd places to sleep, from cardboard boxes to shopping bags and just about anywhere else they decide belongs to them. But Amazon has a cozy little hideaway that may make their usual nap spots look pretty boring.

The Mellownido UFO Cat Bed Cave looks like a tiny flying saucer, complete with a domed top, round peekaboo windows, and a plush cream-and-gold design. And while the spaceship shape is undeniably adorable, this bed has more to offer than good looks.

It can also be used three different ways, giving kitties the option to hide away, curl up together, or stretch out for a nap.

Amazon's Cozy UFO Cat Bed Works as a Cave, Donut Bed or Padded Mat

Shop it!

Priced at $32.99, the bed measures approximately 27.5 inches across and 19.7 inches tall when fully assembled. The enclosed cave has a 15.7-inch opening, making this one a potential option for bigger kitties who don't always fit comfortably inside novelty beds. You can also open the zippered dome to turn the spaceship into a roomy donut-style bed, or remove it to use the padded base on its own. 

According to the brand, the enclosed cave suits cats up to 25 pounds, while the open configuration accommodates cats up to 30 pounds, which could come in handy in multi-cat homes or for cats whose sleeping preferences seem to change by the hour.

The soft polyester covering has a sherpa-like texture made for snuggling, while the raised rim gives cats something to lean against or use as a headrest. Those little windows around the dome aren't just part of the spaceship aesthetic, either. They let curious kitties peek out or poke their paws through while they're tucked inside.

Cleanup is fairly simple, too. The inner cushion is removable and machine washable, while the upper portion should be wiped clean with a damp cloth.

Shoppers have given the UFO bed 4.2 out of 5 stars across 69 global ratings, and several specifically mention how much their cats enjoy its enclosed design.

"I was worried my chunky cat wouldn't be able to fit in this, but he does, and was immediately obsessed as soon as we set it out!!" one shopper shared, adding that its soft texture quickly inspired some biscuit-making.

Another reported, "My kitty is obsessed. She loves the hideaway value and all the peekaboo windows!"

For $32.99, this little spaceship gives cats more than one way to settle in while adding something seriously cute to the room. And for kitties who already know they're the center of the universe, an out-of-this-world nap spot seems pretty fitting.
